app.name: Philax
app.footer: Debates are AI reconstructions grounded in documented works. No one is declared the winner — you decide.

home.heading: What do you want to examine?
home.inputLabel: Paste a link or write an idea
home.placeholder: e.g. Will artificial intelligence make people less creative?
home.hint: A question, a claim, a passage of text, or a link to an article.
examples: Does technology make people more free?
Is it ever right to break the law?
how: We analyse your input into claims, assumptions and open questions.
We find perspectives that genuinely disagree — and thinkers who documented them.
They debate over several rounds, citing sources. You can step in at any time.
home.detectedUrl: Link detected — we will read the article and debate its claims.

challenge.heading: Challenge my idea
challenge.intro: State an idea you hold. We will build the strongest case for it, the strongest case against it, an alternative framing, and surface its hidden assumptions.

challenge.placeholder: e.g. Remote work is always better.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: What we store: your email, a hashed password, your debates (input text or link, extracted article text, analysis and generated turns) and usage counters used to enforce daily limits.
Why: to run and show your debates, let you return to saved debates, and protect the service from abuse.
How long: until you delete the debate or your account. Sessions expire after 30 days. Operational logs exclude your content.
Deletion: you can delete any debate, or your whole account and all associated data, from “My debates”. Deletion is immediate and permanent.
AI providers: to generate debates, relevant parts of your input are sent to the configured AI provider. API keys stay on our servers.
